deals.headline: Van Seumeren sells part of FC Utrecht to new private shareholders, cutting his stake to 60%
deals.investor: Johann Kaemingk, Dennis Okhuijsen and other private investors
deals.summary: Majority owner Frans van Seumeren brought in several investors and reduced his own holding to sixty percent; stock trader Johann Kaemingk and former Altice chief Dennis Okhuijsen were among the new shareholders. No price or individual stakes were disclosed.

deals.headline: FC Utrecht buys Stadion Galgenwaard from owner Jan Spelt
deals.summary: FC Utrecht bought the shares of Galgenwaard Onroerend Goed B.V., owner of Stadion Galgenwaard, from stadium owner Jan Spelt after 53 years as tenant; Jongerius Invest and Dick Uittenbogert took the adjoining corner buildings for area development. The price was not disclosed.

deals.headline: FC Utrecht issues EUR 12.5m of new shares to fund the stadium purchase
deals.summary: The stadium purchase was mostly financed with equity through a EUR 12.5m share issue; Frans van Seumeren Holding's stake went from 58% (2022/23) to 50.1% (2023/24).

name: Football Club Utrecht B.V.
notes: Latest published accounts are 2024/25 (year to 30 June 2025, published October 2025); the 2025/26 report was not yet on fcutrecht.nl on 2026-10-03. Revenue is the audited consolidated net turnover of EUR 35,995,994 (the directors' report text gives EUR 35,995,989). Player-trading result (EUR 6,187,523) is reported below operating result; net result after tax was EUR 50,000 positive. Shareholder loan of EUR 9,883,032 outstanding at 30 June 2025 (four facilities at 3-6.5%, secured on 2025/26 media money). Van Seumeren's 2008 entry: his holding's site says 'In 2008 legde Frans 16 miljoen euro op tafel voor FC Utrecht' (fvsh.nl). The other shareholders' individual stakes are not published; In September 2021 VI reported (as quoted by UtrechtFans) that Van Seumeren's holding then owned 58% and five other shareholders 41%, none above 20%. No valuation, social-follower count or honours figure found on a citable page. Chair is chair of the supervisory board; the club has a two-person board (general director Edo Keuning, technical director Jordy Zuidam) since 1 September 2025.

ownership_summary: Football Club Utrecht B.V. is majority-owned (50.1%) by Frans van Seumeren Holding B.V., the holding of businessman Frans van Seumeren, who bought into the club in 2008. Stichting Continuïteit FC Utrecht holds 1% with a protective say over share transfers, the shirt, the venue and the academy; the remaining shares are spread over other private shareholders, among them stock trader Johann Kaemingk and former Altice chief Dennis Okhuijsen, who came in when Van Seumeren sold down in 2020. No fund, sovereign or other institutional holder is disclosed.
